Coram : A.K. SIKRI*, ABHAY MANOHAR SAPRE
Limitation Act, 1963 - s.5 - Applicability of - Delay in filing revision petition under special law - Condonation of - Delay in filing revision petitions in the High Court under VAT Act - Condonation of delay sought uls.5 of Limitation Act - High Court dismissed the application for condonation of .5 of Limitation Act are not applicable to a proceeding uls.81 of the VAT Act - On appeal, held: Applicability of the provisions of the Limitation Act, is to be judged ft"om the provisions of the special Act and not ft"om the terms of Limitation Act - s.84 of the VAT Act made only ss.4,
Decision Date : 04-01-2017 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 49/2017 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
